Nora (Partnerships): Quick sync - hardware partner needs clear guidance for HSM attestation + SOC uploads. partners asked for a machine-friendly manifest and an example CI workflow.

Priya (HW Partner): we can emit a signed attestation (PKCS7) from our HSM vendor. need to know exact path & how you want the signature stored.

Diego (Security Eng): put attestation under hsm/attestation.bin and signature as hsm/attestation.sig. manifest should include sha256, endorsement_type (pkcs7|jwt), and contact email.

Kelsey (Marketplace PM): marketing timeline: draft listing week of 06/10. can security finish verification by 06/03?

Diego (Security Eng): yes if partners run our pre-check GH Action. i'll publish a tiny manifest v2 and a GH Action snippet that does redaction checks, computes hashes, requests presign, uploads.

Priya (HW Partner): that GH Action sounds good. we do have logs that include IPs; what's your redaction expectation?

Diego (Security Eng): replace PII with <REDACTED>. we'll publish a regex list. if redaction isn't fully automated, partners can submit an interim attestation but public listing will be delayed.

Omar (Legal): add a mandatory attestation statement (name, title, date) and a checkbox confirming partner has rights to share pen-test findings. I'll provide a template link.

ingest-bot: Reminder: presign upload window 2025-05-20T00:00Z -> 2025-06-03T23:59Z. Use presign flow only.

Nora (Partnerships): Proposed manifest layout example:
manifest.yaml fields: schema, version, owner, artifacts[] with path/type/sha256, metadata.upload_date, metadata.region, metadata.contact.

Diego (Security Eng): small GH Action snippet (partner side) will: run redaction checks, make manifest, POST to /presign, upload via presign.

Kelsey (Marketplace PM): retention policy check: keep evidence 18 months (gov:36 months). include in runbook.

Priya (HW Partner): practical q: attestation blob size limit?

Diego (Security Eng): prefer <=10MB; if bigger host externally and reference a signed URL in manifest.

Omar (Legal): posted attestation sample: https://drive.redwood.example/legal/partner-attestation-sample.md

Nora (Partnerships): Plan: partners adopt manifest v2 + GH Action by 2025-05-15. upload window 05-20 -> 06-03. security verify by 06-06. marketing draft 06/10. I'll compile partner checklist and ticket template.

Diego (Security Eng): i'll open repo with manifest schema + redaction rules + verification tooling and post link here.

Nora (Partnerships): thanks all — please flag missing items in 24h. :pray:
